sites.ownership: The scoped signal block borrows one compare pane signal handler id.
sites.justification: The RAII guard blocks and unblocks the peer value-changed handler around a direct adjustment write, avoiding recursive sync without leaving handlers muted on early returns.

sites.ownership: Each review tab owns the optional compare-side ReviewSession for its rendered Git review.
sites.justification: The session must be shared by cursor actions, stale banners, change-list navigation, and renderer refreshes while staying private to the tab.

sites.ownership: The window-owned zoom controller owns the resolved base editor font description.
sites.justification: Zoom and font changes need one mutable source of truth that can update all open tabs and the minimap without duplicating state per tab.

sites.ownership: The window-owned zoom controller owns the current zoom percentage for the whole workspace window.
sites.justification: Window-scoped zoom actions must clamp, reset, and reapply the same percentage across every attached editor tab.

sites.ownership: The typed Git process boundary owns the removable operation-timeout source handle.
sites.justification: Completed Git subprocesses remove this pending GLib timeout source immediately so stale local callbacks cannot survive into later main-context iterations or tests.

sites.ownership: The typed Git process boundary owns the removable post-cancel kill-grace source handle.
sites.justification: Timeout cancellation installs a short fallback kill source only while the Git subprocess is unfinished, and completion removes it before the source can outlive the owning main-context turn.

sites.ownership: The typed Git process boundary owns the Gio subprocess pipe flags.
sites.justification: V9 allows subprocess use only here to run bundled /app/bin/git with typed operations, no shell, bounded output, fixed env, and reviewable argv construction.

sites.ownership: The typed Git process boundary owns stdout capture for sandbox Git.
sites.justification: Git status, attributes, blob reads, and commit responses are bounded and parsed only through this reviewed runner.

sites.ownership: The typed Git process boundary owns stderr capture for sandbox Git.
sites.justification: Captured stderr is size-capped and mapped to user-facing errors without exposing a generic command runner.

sites.ownership: The typed Git process boundary owns subprocess creation.
sites.justification: All Git subprocess invocations go through the allowlisted operation methods in this file and use bundled /app/bin/git, no host PATH lookup, no shell, and deterministic environment overrides.

sites.ownership: The typed Git process boundary owns post-communication subprocess completion.
sites.justification: Git stdout/stderr capture now waits for the reviewed /app/bin/git subprocess to exit before reading status, avoiding GLib status precondition criticals while preserving bounded output handling.

sites.ownership: The typed Git process boundary owns timeout supervision for one Gio subprocess.
sites.justification: The timeout path only observes and cancels subprocesses created by the reviewed /app/bin/git runner, keeping sandbox Git operations bounded without adding a generic command surface.

sites.ownership: The typed Git process boundary owns one completion flag shared by the communicate callback and timeout grace callback.
sites.justification: The GLib timeout has no Gio cancellable handle of its own, so a main-thread Cell prevents late timeout cleanup from force-ending an already completed Git subprocess.

sites.ownership: The typed Git process boundary owns one timeout flag shared by the communicate callback and timeout callback.
sites.justification: The GLib timeout cancels through the same Gio cancellable as user cancellation, so a main-thread Cell preserves the timeout cause until result mapping reports a degraded timeout state.

sites.ownership: The typed Git process boundary owns forced termination of timed-out or kill-on-cancel Git subprocesses.
sites.justification: Only subprocesses spawned by this reviewed /app/bin/git boundary reach this helper, mutating user-cancel paths bypass it, and the helper exits early for completed processes before calling Gio force_exit.

sites.ownership: The Git process test support owns a one-shot callback result slot.
sites.justification: GTK Git fixture setup runs through the typed Git subprocess boundary and pumps the GLib main context until each setup command callback completes.

sites.ownership: Git process unit tests own this callback result slot.
sites.justification: The slot bridges the asynchronous Gio subprocess callback into deterministic test assertions without affecting runtime application state.

sites.justification: Directory enumeration stores cancellables for root-change cancellation; completed loads remove their cancellable from the shared set so long project sessions do not retain stale handles.

sites.justification: The timeout source must avoid overlapping directory enumerations on slow portal or network filesystems.

sites.ownership: The directory snapshot transition helper mutates shared polling state.
sites.justification: Snapshot comparison is centralized so root and loaded-dir polling trigger refreshes only on visible structural changes.

sites.ownership: Runtime icon setup owns the developer-only icon directory guard.
sites.justification: This probe only runs for the explicit RITEED_DEV_ICON_DIR development override during startup and is not used for project, document, portal, or user-selected paths.

sites.ownership: The Source Control controller owns the sidebar state behind one Rc<RefCell>, including the selected-tab URI used for row highlighting.
sites.justification: Refresh, commit, stage, unstage, diff, and active-row callbacks all complete asynchronously on the main loop and need one cancellable, generation-aware UI state owner.

sites.ownership: The Source Control history widget owns the last successfully loaded HEAD.
sites.justification: Recent commits are refetched only when HEAD changes or a previous history read failed, preventing index-only refresh flicker.

sites.ownership: The Source Control history widget owns its transient retry flag.
sites.justification: A failed recent-commits read must self-heal on the next successful status refresh without refetching on every index-only update.

sites.ownership: The Source Control history widget owns the session-only collapsed state for its recent-commits section.
sites.justification: The collapse toggle must be readable by refresh callbacks so collapsed history stays hidden while marking itself dirty for the next expand.

sites.ownership: The Source Control history widget owns the last expanded split position.
sites.justification: Collapse moves the history pane to its minimum height and expand restores the user's previous split position without persisting preference state.

sites.ownership: Shared source-control row module owns the bound-row registry alias.
sites.justification: List and tree views both register and look up row widgets via this Rc<RefCell<>>-backed alias; the shared definition removes the prior duplicate alias.

sites.justification: The flat ListView factory is created before controller Rc wiring and must dispatch row actions against the current snapshot without retaining the window.
